verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a case-management review queue: alerts are prioritised and filterable by risk, stage and assignee. Reviewers record case decisions (no risk, accepted, offboard), and those decisions are kept in a per-case audit trail. Complex cases are escalated to human review. However, the reviewed evidence is screening and monitoring alerts, not identity-verification evidence. missing for 10: document images in the review queue, extracted document fields, ID-verification check results, explicit evidence that decisions write back to the verification record, independent corroboration.
